title: Replacement Purchase Bonus on Kessler Care Total-Loss Refunds
content:
# Replacement Purchase Bonus

When a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan is cancelled for a total loss, a replacement purchase bonus rewards a vehicle bought from the group shortly before. The bonus counts the vehicle price charges posted on the customer's Kessler vehicle purchase deals, less the vehicle price charges reversed, as the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records show them. Within each window, the count is the charges posted with a date in that window less the charges reversed with a date in that window. Windows are measured back from the effective date, which is the request date.

| Net vehicle price charges | Replacement purchase bonus (USD) |
|---|---|
| One or more dated fewer than 1 whole month before the effective date | 30.00 |
| Otherwise, one or more dated fewer than 3 whole months before | 15.00 |
| None | None |

## Cases (hypothetical, effective date 20 September)
| Vehicle price charges | Bonus |
|---|---|
| One posted 2 September | 30.00 |
| One posted 20 August (1 whole month back) | 15.00 |
| One posted 21 June (2 whole months back) | 15.00 |
| One posted 20 June (3 whole months back) | none |
| One posted 2 September and reversed 10 September | none |

Only vehicle price charges count. Deposits, fees and other charges on a deal are not counted.
